question: I’m reading the published work. I was surprised to read that Puck governs fire. Is the ice he normally uses the sort of thing created by use of heat manipulation, like a ‘minus one trillion degrees’ thing? Will the time comes when he uses fire outright?
answer: It’s a little bothersome, but ‘Fire’ is the temperature controlling line, so both flames and ice are part of the ‘Fire’ system. Sorry it’s hard to understand. As for whether Puck will ever use fire or not, please look forward to it.
